text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 25px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202735

g.text: Small experiments identify mechanisms, not universal laws

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: Baseline Qwen2.5-7B + MOSS/MMS. Real model executions; all candidate attempts retained. Separate groups are not pooled.

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: Mean valid: 4.17 / 6.50 / 11.17. Attempts with a selectable line:

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: 10/12 / 10/12 / 12/12. Lines pair workloads; diamonds are medians.

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: Median: 91 / 95 / 156 ms. Cold n16 observation is retained.

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: No fitted cost curve; n32 always occupied the middle order position.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: Three paired groups; 12 bars/condition, from shared sessions.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: MOSS ~1.78 s in both; total 1.81 -> 3.58 s. Residual = total minus

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: measured synthesis/alignment. Separate medians do not add up.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: Three matched seeds/condition; medians 1.917 / 3.799 / 3.826 s.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: Final topics differ: this is not a causal cost-per-edit estimate.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: Source receipt is not an audible response measurement.

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202735

g.text: G5: 12 Mac preparation observations, median 49.99 ms / max 59.17 ms. Two Mac receipts: 5.786 / 7.794 s, including prior work and transport.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b34c42

g.text: No listening-quality study, acoustic onset measurement, tail guarantee or statistical significance claim. Route-median subtraction cannot isolate SSH latency.
